test_title: PYST 1: RRB NTPC (UG) CBT-I - Reasoning (Held On: 07 Aug, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question:
Based on the English alphabetical order, three of the following four letter-cluster pairs are alike in a certain way and thus form a group. Which letter-cluster pair DOES NOT belong to that group?

(Note: The odd one out is not based on the number of consonants/vowels or their position in the letter-cluster.)
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bd3c600bf09d7de25d7d22479d848ddead62c9f7437c41312681e3719e85d12d.png] 

The logic followed here is:

Option 1) PN - QO

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f493d8e4208b07747e7506ad9cc91306c7dff20f0d37e7cc6f6b0e4eca632f63.png] 

Option 2) QO - RP

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/21a0a642afdd982dc04c5f5baed25c385e2dbff1a4873befe9d9a7c2376cefa1.png] 

Option 3) LJ - MK

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4b345e6aca863ce6e24b21e475ae8c3c4c6e16e23fda7f3ba96f12a8e0809980.png] 

Option (4): US → UV

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/13876699bd46a105e5cf87feffcac70aeea07695c9b1107ad7ecb265696c1f8a.png] 

Thus, odd letter-cluster pair is: US−UV.

Hence, **"Option 4"** is the correct answer.
